name: World Organization of the Scout Movement
body: HSTS is preloaded, every image analyzed has alt text, every page a meta description, and language versions link back. OneTrust loads, but no Consent Mode default is set, so Google tags may fire before a choice.
lesson: Set consent defaults to denied before Tag Manager loads; OneTrust then updates them.
summary: www.scout.org scores 81 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: no content security policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 6.5 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 256 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.02 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer…

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 25/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 32.3 s, Total Blocking Time 4540 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.034, Speed Index 17.3 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 9 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
